QuestInfo.name: [Crimsonheart] Night Marks
QuestInfo.1: Obtain Night Marks by entering the portal to the right of Ridley and playing through the mini-game. You can obtain a perfect emblem at the end or by collecting Night Mark Fragments from the boxes scattered around. 100 Night Mark Fragments can make a Night Mark.
QuestInfo.2: You got Night Marks by entering the portal to the right of Ridley and playing the mini-game.
